passages.text: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Jeroboam son of Nebat, Abijam became king of Judah, and he reigned in Jerusalem three years. His mother’s name was Maacah daughter of Abishalom.
passages.sermon:
Jeroboam was king of Israel.
Jeroboam was the son of Nebat.
In the eighteenth year of Jeroboam’s reign, Abijam became king.
Abijam became king over Judah.
Abijam ruled in Jerusalem.
Abijam ruled for three years.
Abijam’s mother was Maacah.
Maacah was the daughter of Abishalom.
passages.original: וּבִשְׁנַת֙ שְׁמֹנֶ֣ה עֶשְׂרֵ֔ה לַמֶּ֖לֶךְ יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן־ נְבָ֑ט מָלַ֥ךְ אֲבִיָּ֖ם עַל־ יְהוּדָֽה׃ שָׁלֹ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֔ים מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ מַעֲכָ֖ה בַּת־ אֲבִישָׁלֽוֹם׃

passages.text: And Abijam walked in all the sins that his father before him had committed, and his heart was not as fully devoted to the LORD his God as the heart of David his forefather had been.
passages.sermon:
Abijam was king of Judah.
Abijam’s father was Rehoboam.
Abijam did what his father did.
Abijam followed all the sins his father committed before him.
Abijam did not have a heart fully devoted to the LORD his God.
David was Abijam’s forefather.
David’s heart was fully devoted to the LORD.
Abijam’s heart was not like David’s heart.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֕לֶךְ בְּכָל־ חַטֹּ֥אות אָבִ֖יו אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֣ה לְפָנָ֑יו וְלֹא־ הָיָ֨ה לְבָב֤וֹ שָׁלֵם֙ עִם־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔יו כִּלְבַ֖ב דָּוִ֥ד אָבִֽיו׃

passages.text: Nevertheless, for the sake of David, the LORD his God gave him a lamp in Jerusalem by raising up a son to succeed him and to make Jerusalem strong.
passages.sermon:
The LORD was the God of Abijam.
The LORD acted for the sake of David.
The LORD gave Abijam a lamp in Jerusalem.
The LORD did this by raising up a son after Abijam.
The LORD did this to make Jerusalem stand strong.
passages.original: כִּ֚י לְמַ֣עַן דָּוִ֔ד נָתַן֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהָ֥יו ל֛וֹ נִ֖יר בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לְהָקִ֤ים אֶת־ בְּנוֹ֙ אַחֲרָ֔יו וּֽלְהַעֲמִ֖יד אֶת־ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: For David had done what was right in the eyes of the LORD and had not turned aside from anything the LORD commanded all the days of his life, except in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.
passages.sermon:
David was king of Israel.
David did what was right in the eyes of the LORD.
David obeyed everything the LORD commanded him.
David did this all the days of his life.
David did not turn aside from the LORD’s commands.
David failed only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.
passages.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֥ה דָוִ֛ד אֶת־ הַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹֽא־ סָ֞ר מִכֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֗הוּ כֹּ֚ל יְמֵ֣י חַיָּ֔יו רַ֕ק בִּדְבַ֖ר אוּרִיָּ֥ה הַחִתִּֽי׃

passages.text: And there was war between the houses of Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of Abijam’s life.
passages.sermon:
Rehoboam was king of Judah.
Jeroboam was king of Israel.
There was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam.
This war lasted all the days of Abijam’s life.
passages.original: וּמִלְחָמָ֨ה הָיְתָ֧ה בֵין־ רְחַבְעָ֛ם וּבֵ֥ין יָרָבְעָ֖ם כָּל־ יְמֵ֥י חַיָּֽיו׃

passages.text: As for the rest of the acts of Abijam, along with all his accomplishments, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.
passages.sermon:
Abijam was a king of Judah.
He did many things during his reign.
People recorded the rest of Abijam’s acts and all he accomplished.
They wrote these things in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah.
Abijam and Jeroboam fought against each other.
There was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.
passages.original: וְיֶ֨תֶר דִּבְרֵ֤י אֲבִיָּם֙ וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה הֲלֽוֹא־ הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וּמִלְחָמָ֥ה הָיְתָ֛ה בֵּ֥ין אֲבִיָּ֖ם וּבֵ֥ין יָרָבְעָֽם׃

passages.text: And Abijam rested with his fathers and was buried in the City of David, and his son Asa reigned in his place.
passages.sermon:
Abijam was king of Judah.
Abijam died.
People buried Abijam in the City of David.
Asa was Abijam’s son.
Asa became king after Abijam.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב אֲבִיָּם֙ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַיִּקְבְּר֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ בְּעִ֣יר דָּוִ֑ד וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אָסָ֥א בְנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ

passages.text: In the twentieth year of Jeroboam’s reign over Israel, Asa became king of Judah, and he reigned in Jerusalem forty-one years. His grandmother’s name was Maacah daughter of Abishalom.
passages.sermon:
Asa became king of Judah.
Jeroboam was king of Israel at that time.
This happened in the twentieth year of Jeroboam’s reign.
Asa ruled in Jerusalem.
He reigned for forty-one years.
Asa’s grandmother was Maacah.
Maacah was the daughter of Abishalom.
passages.original: וּבִשְׁנַ֣ת עֶשְׂרִ֔ים לְיָרָבְעָ֖ם מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מָלַ֥ךְ אָסָ֖א מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃ וְאַרְבָּעִ֤ים וְאַחַת֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ מַעֲכָ֖ה בַּת־ אֲבִישָׁלֽוֹם׃

passages.text: And Asa did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, as his father David had done.
passages.sermon:
Asa was king of Judah.
Asa did what was right.
The LORD saw Asa’s actions as right.
David was Asa’s ancestor.
David also did what was right in the eyes of the LORD.
Asa acted like David.
passages.original: וַיַּ֧עַשׂ אָסָ֛א הַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּדָוִ֖ד אָבִֽיו׃

passages.text: He banished the male shrine prostitutes from the land and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.
passages.sermon:
Asa was king of Judah.
He ruled in Jerusalem.
He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD.
He banished the male shrine prostitutes from the land.
He removed all the idols.
His fathers had made these idols.
passages.original: וַיַּעֲבֵ֥ר הַקְּדֵשִׁ֖ים מִן־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיָּ֙סַר֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַגִּלֻּלִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשׂ֖וּ אֲבֹתָֽיו׃

passages.text: He also removed his grandmother Maacah from her position as queen mother because she had made a detestable Asherah pole. Asa chopped down the pole and burned it in the Kidron Valley.
passages.sermon:
Asa was king of Judah.
Maacah was Asa’s grandmother.
Maacah served as queen mother.
Maacah made a detestable Asherah pole.
Asa removed Maacah from her position as queen mother.
Asa cut down the Asherah pole.
Asa burned the pole in the Kidron Valley.
passages.original: וְגַ֣ם׀ אֶת־ מַעֲכָ֣ה אִמּ֗וֹ וַיְסִרֶ֙הָ֙ מִגְּבִירָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ עָשְׂתָ֥ה מִפְלֶ֖צֶת לָאֲשֵׁרָ֑ה וַיִּכְרֹ֤ת אָסָא֙ אֶת־ מִפְלַצְתָּ֔הּ וַיִּשְׂרֹ֖ף בְּנַ֥חַל קִדְרֽוֹן׃

passages.text: The high places were not removed, but Asa’s heart was fully devoted to the LORD all his days.
passages.sermon:
Asa was king of Judah.
He did not remove the high places.
People still worshiped at these high places.
But Asa’s heart was fully devoted to the LORD.
He stayed faithful to God all his life.
passages.original: וְהַבָּמ֖וֹת לֹא־ סָ֑רוּ רַ֣ק לְבַב־ אָסָ֗א הָיָ֥ה שָׁלֵ֛ם עִם־ יְהוָ֖ה כָּל־ יָמָֽיו׃

passages.text: And he brought into the house of the LORD the silver and gold and other articles that he and his father had dedicated.
passages.sermon:
Asa was king of Judah.
Asa honored God.
Asa took silver, gold, and other valuable items.
Asa’s father had dedicated these items to God.
Asa also dedicated his own gifts to God.
Asa brought all these things into the house of the LORD.
passages.original: וַיָּבֵא֙ אֶת־ קָדְשֵׁ֣י אָבִ֔יו וְקָדְשׁוֹ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה כֶּ֥סֶף וְזָהָ֖ב וְכֵלִֽים׃

passages.text: Now there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel throughout their days.
passages.sermon:
Asa was king of Judah.
Baasha was king of Israel.
Asa and Baasha fought each other.
They were at war for their entire reigns.
passages.original: וּמִלְחָמָ֨ה הָיְתָ֜ה בֵּ֣ין אָסָ֗א וּבֵ֛ין בַּעְשָׁ֥א מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כָּל־ יְמֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Baasha king of Israel went to war against Judah and fortified Ramah to prevent anyone from leaving or entering the territory of Asa king of Judah.
passages.sermon:
Baasha was king of Israel.
He went to war against Judah.
He built up the city of Ramah.
He made Ramah strong with walls and defenses.
He did this to control movement.
He wanted to stop people from leaving or entering Judah.
He wanted to block Asa, who was king of Judah.
No one could go out or come in to Asa’s territory because of Baasha’s actions.
passages.original: וַיַּ֨עַל בַּעְשָׁ֤א מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ עַל־ יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיִּ֖בֶן אֶת־ הָרָמָ֑ה לְבִלְתִּ֗י תֵּ֚ת יֹצֵ֣א וָבָ֔א לְאָסָ֖א מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: So Asa withdrew all the silver and gold that remained in the treasuries of the house of the LORD and the royal palace. He entrusted it to his servants and sent them with this message to Ben-hadad son of Tabrimmon, the son of Hezion king of Aram, who was ruling in Damascus: “Let there be a treaty between me and you, between my father and your father. See, I have sent you a gift of silver and gold. Now go and break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, so that he will withdraw from me.”
passages.sermon:
Asa was king of Judah.
Baasha was king of Israel.
There was war between Asa and Baasha all their days.
Baasha attacked Judah.
He blocked the city of Ramah.
He wanted to stop people from entering or leaving Asa’s land.
Asa took all the silver and gold left in the treasuries of the house of the LORD.
He also took the treasures from the royal palace.
Asa gave this silver and gold to his servants.
He sent his servants to Ben-hadad.
Ben-hadad was king of Aram.
Ben-hadad lived in Damascus.
Asa sent this message to Ben-hadad:
“There is a treaty between me and you.
There was also a treaty between my father and your father.
I have sent you a gift of silver and gold.
Go and break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel.
Then Baasha will leave me alone.”
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח אָ֠סָא אֶת־ כָּל־ הַכֶּ֨סֶף וְהַזָּהָ֜ב הַֽנּוֹתָרִ֣ים׀ בְּאוֹצְר֣וֹת בֵּית־ יְהוָ֗ה וְאֶת־ אֽוֹצְרוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית מֶלֶךְ וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֖ם בְּיַד־ עֲבָדָ֑יו וַיִּשְׁלָחֵ֞ם הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אָסָ֗א אֶל־ בֶּן־ הֲ֠דַד בֶּן־ טַבְרִמֹּ֤ן בֶּן־ חֶזְיוֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֔ם הַיֹּשֵׁ֥ב בְּדַמֶּ֖שֶׂק לֵאמֹֽר׃ בְּרִית֙ בֵּינִ֣י וּבֵינֶ֔ךָ בֵּ֥ין אָבִ֖י וּבֵ֣ין אָבִ֑יךָ הִנֵּה֩ שָׁלַ֨חְתִּֽי לְךָ֥ שֹׁ֙חַד֙ כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֔ב לֵ֣ךְ הָפֵ֗רָה אֶת־ בְּרִֽיתְךָ֙ אֶת־ בַּעְשָׁ֣א מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְיַעֲלֶ֖ה מֵעָלָֽי׃

passages.text: And Ben-hadad listened to King Asa and sent the commanders of his armies against the cities of Israel, conquering Ijon, Dan, Abel-beth-maacah, and the whole land of Naphtali, including the region of Chinnereth.
passages.sermon:
Ben-hadad was the king of Aram.  
King Asa of Judah sent a message and a gift to Ben-hadad.  
Ben-hadad listened to King Asa.  
Ben-hadad sent the commanders of his armies.  
He sent them against the cities of Israel.  
Ben-hadad’s armies attacked Ijon.  
They attacked Dan.  
They attacked Abel-beth-maacah.  
They attacked the whole region of Chinnereth.  
They attacked all the land of Naphtali.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֨ע בֶּן־ הֲדַ֜ד אֶל־ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אָסָ֗א וַ֠יִּשְׁלַח אֶת־ שָׂרֵ֨י הַחֲיָלִ֤ים אֲשֶׁר־ לוֹ֙ עַל־ עָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיַּךְ֙ אֶת־ עִיּ֣וֹן וְאֶת־ דָּ֔ן וְאֵ֖ת אָבֵ֣ל בֵּֽית־ מַעֲכָ֑ה וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ כִּנְר֔וֹת עַ֖ל כָּל־ אֶ֥רֶץ נַפְתָּלִֽי׃

passages.text: When Baasha learned of this, he stopped fortifying Ramah and withdrew to Tirzah.
passages.sermon:
Baasha was the king of Israel.
Baasha heard what happened.
He stopped building up the city of Ramah.
Baasha left Ramah.
He went to live in Tirzah.
passages.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ כִּשְׁמֹ֣עַ בַּעְשָׁ֔א וַיֶּחְדַּ֕ל מִבְּנ֖וֹת אֶת־ הָֽרָמָ֑ה וַיֵּ֖שֶׁב בְּתִרְצָֽה׃

passages.text: Then King Asa summoned all the men of Judah, with no exceptions, and they carried away the stones of Ramah and the timbers Baasha had used for building. And with these materials King Asa built up Geba of Benjamin, as well as Mizpah.
passages.sermon:
King Asa ruled over Judah.
King Asa called all the men of Judah.
He did not leave anyone out.
The men of Judah carried away the stones from Ramah.
They also carried away the timbers from Ramah.
Baasha had used these stones and timbers to build.
King Asa used these materials.
He built up Geba in the land of Benjamin.
He also built up Mizpah.
passages.original: וְהַמֶּ֨לֶךְ אָסָ֜א הִשְׁמִ֤יעַ אֶת־ כָּל־ יְהוּדָה֙ אֵ֣ין נָקִ֔י וַיִּשְׂא֞וּ אֶת־ אַבְנֵ֤י הָֽרָמָה֙ וְאֶת־ עֵצֶ֔יהָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנָ֖ה בַּעְשָׁ֑א וַיִּ֤בֶן בָּם֙ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אָסָ֔א אֶת־ גֶּ֥בַע בִּנְיָמִ֖ן וְאֶת־ הַמִּצְפָּֽה׃

passages.text: Now the rest of the acts of Asa, along with all his might, all his accomplishments, and the cities he built, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah? In his old age, however, he became diseased in his feet.
passages.sermon:
Asa was king of Judah.
He did many things.
He showed great strength.
He accomplished much.
He built cities.
The Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah records these things.
When Asa became old, he developed a disease in his feet.
passages.original: וְיֶ֣תֶר כָּל־ דִּבְרֵֽי־ אָ֠סָא וְכָל־ גְּב֨וּרָת֜וֹ וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֗ה וְהֶֽעָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּנָ֔ה הֲלֹֽא־ הֵ֣מָּה כְתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה רַ֚ק לְעֵ֣ת זִקְנָת֔וֹ חָלָ֖ה אֶת־ רַגְלָֽיו׃

passages.text: And Asa rested with his fathers and was buried with them in the city of his father David, and his son Jehoshaphat reigned in his place.
passages.sermon:
King Asa ruled over Judah.
Asa died.
People buried Asa with his ancestors.
They buried him in the city of David, his father.
Jehoshaphat was Asa’s son.
Jehoshaphat became king after Asa.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב אָסָא֙ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַיִּקָּבֵר֙ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֔יו בְּעִ֖יר דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֑יו וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ

passages.text: In the second year of Asa’s reign over Judah, Nadab son of Jeroboam became king of Israel, and he reigned two years.
passages.sermon:
Nadab was the son of Jeroboam.
Asa was the king of Judah.
In the second year of Asa’s reign, Nadab became king of Israel.
Nadab ruled Israel for two years.
passages.original: וְנָדָ֣ב בֶּן־ יָרָבְעָ֗ם מָלַךְ֙ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בִּשְׁנַ֣ת שְׁתַּ֔יִם לְאָסָ֖א מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיִּמְלֹ֥ךְ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שְׁנָתָֽיִם׃

passages.text: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD and walked in the way of his father and in his sin, which he had caused Israel to commit.
passages.sermon:
Nadab was king of Israel.
Nadab was the son of Jeroboam.
Nadab did evil in the sight of the LORD.
Nadab followed the ways of his father Jeroboam.
Nadab committed the same sins as his father.
Jeroboam had caused Israel to sin.
Nadab also caused Israel to sin.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיֵּ֙לֶךְ֙ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ אָבִ֔יו וּ֨בְחַטָּאת֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Then Baasha son of Ahijah of the house of Issachar conspired against Nadab, and Baasha struck him down at Gibbethon of the Philistines while Nadab and all Israel were besieging the city.
passages.sermon:
Baasha was the son of Ahijah.
Baasha belonged to the house of Issachar.
Nadab was the king of Israel.
Baasha conspired against Nadab.
Baasha attacked Nadab at Gibbethon.
Gibbethon belonged to the Philistines.
Nadab and all Israel were besieging Gibbethon at that time.
Baasha struck down Nadab during the siege.
passages.original: וַיִּקְשֹׁ֨ר עָלָ֜יו בַּעְשָׁ֤א בֶן־ אֲחִיָּה֙ לְבֵ֣ית יִשָּׂשכָ֔ר וַיַּכֵּ֣הוּ בַעְשָׁ֔א בְּגִבְּת֖וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר לַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וְנָדָב֙ וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל צָרִ֖ים עַֽל־ גִּבְּתֽוֹן׃

passages.text: In the third year of Asa’s reign over Judah, Baasha killed Nadab and reigned in his place.
passages.sermon:
Baasha was a man from the house of Issachar.
Asa was the king of Judah.
Asa had ruled Judah for three years.
In the third year of Asa’s reign, Baasha killed Nadab.
Nadab was the king of Israel.
After Baasha killed Nadab, Baasha became king.
Baasha ruled in Nadab’s place.
passages.original: וַיְמִתֵ֣הוּ בַעְשָׁ֔א בִּשְׁנַ֣ת שָׁלֹ֔שׁ לְאָסָ֖א מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיִּמְלֹ֖ךְ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃

passages.text: As soon as Baasha became king, he struck down the entire household of Jeroboam. He did not leave to Jeroboam anyone that breathed, but destroyed them all according to the word that the LORD had spoken through His servant Ahijah the Shilonite, because of the sins Jeroboam had committed and had caused Israel to commit, and because he had provoked the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger.
passages.sermon:
Baasha became king of Israel.
Baasha killed every member of Jeroboam’s family.
Baasha did not leave anyone alive from Jeroboam’s household.
Baasha destroyed them all.
The LORD had spoken this word through His servant Ahijah the Shilonite.
The LORD said this would happen because Jeroboam sinned.
Jeroboam also led Israel to sin.
Jeroboam made the LORD, the God of Israel, angry.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֣י כְמָלְכ֗וֹ הִכָּה֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ בֵּ֣ית יָרָבְעָ֔ם לֹֽא־ הִשְׁאִ֧יר כָּל־ נְשָׁמָ֛ה לְיָרָבְעָ֖ם עַד־ הִשְׁמִד֑וֹ כִּדְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֔ר בְּיַד־ עַבְדּ֖וֹ אֲחִיָּ֥ה הַשִּׁילֹנִֽי׃ עַל־ חַטֹּ֤אות יָרָבְעָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטָ֔א וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּכַעְס֕וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִכְעִ֔יס אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: As for the rest of the acts of Nadab, along with all his accomplishments, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
passages.sermon:
Nadab was a king of Israel.
He did many things during his reign.
The rest of Nadab’s acts are recorded.
All his accomplishments are written down.
They are in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.
passages.original: וְיֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י נָדָ֖ב וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲלֹא־ הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel throughout their days.
passages.sermon:
Asa was king of Judah.
Baasha was king of Israel.
Asa and Baasha fought each other.
They were at war for their entire lives.
passages.original: וּמִלְחָמָ֨ה הָיְתָ֜ה בֵּ֣ין אָסָ֗א וּבֵ֛ין בַּעְשָׁ֥א מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כָּל־ יְמֵיהֶֽם׃פ

passages.text: In the third year of Asa’s reign over Judah, Baasha son of Ahijah became king of all Israel, and he reigned in Tirzah twenty-four years.
passages.sermon:
Asa was king of Judah.
Baasha was the son of Ahijah.
In the third year of Asa’s reign, Baasha became king.
Baasha ruled over all Israel.
Baasha ruled in the city of Tirzah.
Baasha reigned for twenty-four years.
passages.original: בִּשְׁנַ֣ת שָׁלֹ֔שׁ לְאָסָ֖א מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה מָ֠לַךְ בַּעְשָׁ֨א בֶן־ אֲחִיָּ֤ה עַל־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּתִרְצָ֔ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבַּ֖ע שָׁנָֽה׃

passages.text: And Baasha did evil in the sight of the LORD and walked in the way of Jeroboam and in his sin, which he had caused Israel to commit.
passages.sermon:
Baasha was king of Israel.
Baasha did evil.
The LORD saw Baasha’s evil.
Baasha followed the way of Jeroboam.
Jeroboam sinned against the LORD.
Baasha sinned as Jeroboam did.
Baasha caused Israel to sin.
Baasha led Israel into sin.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיֵּ֙לֶךְ֙ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ יָרָבְעָ֔ם וּ֨בְחַטָּאת֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
